title: Protocol for inducing cellular ablation in the mouse atrioventricular conduction system
protocol: Place adult (P42) mouse on metal grid.
Grasp loose skin at the back of the neck between thumb and forefinger.
Hold tail with little and ring finger.
Perform injection of 1 mg Tamoxifen in lower right abdomen at a 30°–40° angle towards thorax.
Aspirate to ensure no liquid is present before administering Tamoxifen solution.
Collect entire litter of neonatal (P0) mice on day 0 and place in a separate cage.
Gently grab a neonatal mouse by the back of the neck and visualize its mouth.
Use a pipettor to obtain 8–10 μL of Tamoxifen equivalent to a single dose.
Position the pipette tip in the animal’s mouth and slowly administer the Tamoxifen solution.
Hold the neonatal mouse upright to ensure ingestion of the Tamoxifen.
Place the treated neonatal mouse in an extra cage for recovery until other mice are given Tamoxifen.
Relocate all neonatal mice (entire litter) back to their original cage after induction.
Gently place your thumb and forefinger on the middle of the thoracic spine to immobilize the neonatal mouse.
Perform injection of a single dose of 1 mg Tamoxifen subcutaneously at the back of the neck in a 20°–30° angle.
Perforate skin and slowly administer Tamoxifen solution.
Place neonatal mouse in an extra cage for recovery until other mice are given Tamoxifen.
Relocate all mice to their original cage after induction.
Anesthetize adult mouse with 2% isoflurane in 2.0 L/min O2.
Place adult mouse in anesthesia chamber and, once anesthetized, place the animal at the mouse pad and hook to rodent facemask.
Anesthetize neonatal mouse with 2% isoflurane in 2.0 L/min O2.
Place neonatal mouse directly on the mouse pad and hook to rodent facemask.
Assess depth of anesthesia by checking loss of righting reflex or response to pain stimulation (e.g., toe pinch).
Place positive (red) electrode at left forelimb for ECG recording.
Place negative (black) electrode at right forelimb for ECG recording.
Place reference (green) electrode at the left hindlimb.
Clean mouse limbs and ECG electrodes with alcohol pads before inserting them into the mouse.
Insert ECG electrodes into the mouse once cleaned.
Click start in LabChart 8 program to record the animal’s ECG.
Record ECG for at least one to one-and-a-half minutes.
Remove ECG electrodes once recording is finished.
Return the animal to its cage.
Freshly prepare pharmacological agents, i.e., Atropine and Isoproterenol.
Record ECG for 1 min.
Perform IP injection of 2 μg/g or 50 ng/g of Atropine or Isoproterenol respectively.
Continue recording the animal’s ECG for 5 min following drug administration.
Place mice in an empty cage and slowly fill with CO₂ at 3 L/min until euthanasia is complete (i.e., no more breathing can be observed).
Perform cervical dislocation as secondary method of euthanasia.
Place euthanized mice in a clean dissection pad.
Cut the chest open to expose the chest cavity.
Cut the major blood vessels connecting the heart to the cardiac base.
Place harvested heart in cold 1× PBS.
Gently pump the harvested heart with forceps to remove excess blood.
Fix the harvested heart in 0.2% glutaraldehyde for one hour at 4°C.
Wash with washing buffer for 10 min twice.
Incubate and shake the harvested heart in X-gal staining buffer at room temperature (20°C–22°C) overnight (12–16 h), covered with foil.
Post-fix the harvested heart in neutral formalin overnight (12–16 h) for paraffin embedding.
Handle para-formaldehyde solution inside a chemical fume hood and wearing protective gear such as glasses, lab coat, and gloves.
Place the harvested heart in a mold in the appropriate orientation.
Embed harvested heart in paraffin.
Section the mouse heart paraffin block in a posterior to anterior (PA) direction.
Collect sections where mitral valve and tricuspid valve are present.
Fix the harvested heart in 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) for one hour at 4°C.
Sequentially incubate the harvested heart in 10% and 20% sucrose/PBS at 4°C for 12–24 h.
Fill a cryomold with Tissue Freezing Medium (TFM).
Place the harvested heart in the TFM-filled cryomold.
Orient the harvested heart into the four-chamber orientation.
Snap-freeze the harvested heart with TFM using dry ice or liquid nitrogen.
Store mouse heart frozen block at -80°C prior to sectioning.
Section the mouse heart frozen block into 8-micron slices in a posterior to anterior (PA) direction, using a Leica CM3050S cryostat.
Collect sections where septal leaflet of the tricuspid valve is present.
Wash paraffin sections with 100% Cedarwood Oil for 5 minutes three times to deparaffinize sections.
Wash sections with a 1:1 mixture of Cedarwood Oil and 100% ethanol for 2 minutes.
Rinse sections three times with 100% ethanol for 5 minutes.
Rinse sections three times with running water for 5 minutes.
Air-dry tissue sections for 15–20 minutes at room temperature (20°C–22°C).
Wash cryosections thoroughly with PBS for 2 minutes twice.
Incubate sections in Harris hematoxylin for 5 seconds.
Wash sections thoroughly in running water for 5 minutes.
Incubate sections in 100% alcohol for 10 seconds.
Incubate sections in eosin for 5 seconds.
Rinse sections in alcohol three times, with a final wash in 100% alcohol for 10 seconds.
Wash sections in xylene for 10 seconds, followed by two additional washes in xylene for 5 seconds each.
Seal sections with cover slips and mounting medium.
Immerse sections in Bouin’s Fluid (preheated to 56°C) for 60 minutes or overnight at room temperature.
Rinse sections with running water for 3 minutes until sections are colorless.
Immerse sections in Modified Mayer’s Hematoxylin for 7 minutes.
Rinse sections with running water for 3 minutes.
Immerse sections in One-Step Trichrome Stain (Blue & Red) for 3–8 minutes.
Rinse sections with running water for 5 s.
Rinse sections three times with absolute alcohol for 1 min.
Rinse sections three times with Xylene for 1 min.
Seal sections with cover slips and mounting medium.
Incubate sections in Nuclear Fast Red solution for 5 min.
Rinse sections with running water for 5 min.
Wash sections three times with 100% ethanol for 2 min.
Rinse sections three times with Xylene for 1 min.
Seal sections with cover slips and mounting medium.
Incubate sections in Acetylthiocholine staining buffer at 37°C overnight (12–16 h).
Rinse section slides with distilled water.
Counterstain section slides with eosin.
Seal sections with cover slips and mounting medium.
Air-dry fixed tissue sections for 15–20 min at room temperature (20°C–22°C).
Wash sections three times with PBS for 5 min.
Add 0.3% Triton-X100 in PBS to the fixed sections and allow permeabilization for 20 min at room temperature (20°C–22°C).
Wash sections three times with PBS for 5 min.
Block fixed sections with Universal Blocking buffer for 10 min at room temperature (20°C–22°C).
Dilute primary antibodies in the appropriate amount and apply 30 μL to each section.
Incubate overnight (12–16 h) at 4°C.
Wash sections three times with PBS for 5 min.
Dilute secondary antibodies in the appropriate amount and apply 30 μL to each section.
Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature (20°C–22°C).
Wash sections with PBS.
Mount tissue sections with Vectashield Mounting Medium with DAPI.
